latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the CamScanner PDF to Office skill.
- Convert PDF files to editable Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx) documents with accurate format preservation.
- Simple 3-step command-line workflow: upload, convert, and download files.
- Requires curl and jq; processes documents via CamScanner’s official servers.
- Comprehensive usage guide and API reference included for easy integration.
